items.title: Was Nvidia’s strong report a clearing event for the wider chip sector?
items.summary: Investing.com -- It’s too early to call the report a clearing event. As of 9:07 AM ET on Nov 18, 2026, the market is closed until 9:30 AM ET, so no regular-session reaction exists yet. The evidence so far is premarket and overseas trading, and it points to a relief bounce on top of unresolved problems.

items.title: Wife of senior Nvidia executive embroiled in chip smuggling scandal
items.summary: The wife of one of Jensen Huang’s most senior allies has been caught up in a chip-smuggling scandal that has engulfed one of Nvidia’s biggest partners.

items.title: Super Micro Computer’s 40% 3 Month Downturn: A Great Entry Point Says This Wall Street Pro Who Predicts 165% Returns
items.summary: Super Micro posted record growth, yet a federal probe and thin margins have sent the stock tumbling while Dell and HPE hold up better. One Raymond James analyst sees a bargain, but most of Wall Street is staying put, and one unresolved question may decide who is right.
